title: Upper semicontinuity of the slice length (Simon's note to 2.10)
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ, j ∈ Fin d and let A ⊆ ℝ^d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) be compact. For y ∈ ℝ^d let λ(y) := (L¹({t ∈ ℝ : y[j↦t] ∈ A})).toReal, where y[j↦t] is y with its j-th coordinate replaced by t (Lean: WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t)) and L¹ is Lebesgue measure on ℝ. Then λ : ℝ^d → ℝ is upper semicontinuous: for every x ∈ ℝ^d and every real r > λ(x) there is a neighbourhood N of x with λ(y) < r for all y ∈ N.
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (j : Fin d) (A : Set (Euclid d)), IsCompact A → UpperSemicontinuous (fun y : Euclid d => (volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}).toReal)
